svg.title: Team mode lifecycle and guardrails
svg.desc: Pipeline of a team run: the session-start complexity gate advises only, the Lead decides the roster and task graph, teammates are spawned and tasks posted, members claim and complete tasks, the wave is compacted and the next wave starts in a new session. A guardrails band lists the read-only tool denial, the durable mailbox, the compare-and-set board and advisory write scopes.
svg.text: Team mode — one wave, end to end
The session agent is the Lead. The official Agent Teams plugin owns the runtime; the workflow around it is the captain's.
Session-start complexity gate — ADVISES, stages nothing
A triggered auto-route injects one notice naming the fired signals and stating that no team was staged; an explicit team: / !team request is advice too.
1 · Decide
The Lead shapes the roster and the task DAG.
Nothing is staged before this step, and the
captain may continue solo and say so.
2 · Stage
spawn_teammate reserves a name and opens a
lane; team_task_create posts its task with an
acceptance contract and optional blockers.
3 · Run
Any member claims a READY task and completes
it. The board is compare-and-set on revision,
so a stale claim cannot overwrite newer work.
4 · Coordinate
send_message · wait_agent · interrupt_agent.
The watchdog lane detects stalls (OUTSTANDING
→ IN-FLIGHT → ALIVE → PARKED), warns, then escalates.
5 · Close the wave
When every task is terminal and every member
idle, mpd_team_compact_run compacts the
members' contexts — the Lead is never compacted.
6 · Next wave
One team per wave: end the team when the wave
lands and start the next one in a new session,
so members and tasks do not accumulate.
Guardrails that hold in every team
Read-only roster names
Architect, Researcher, Planner,
Explorer, Plan Reviewer and Vision
Analyst are denied the seven write
tools by a guard — bash included.
Durable mailbox
A message is stored before delivery,
so the result is accepted or queued.
A queued message is already stored
— never resend it.
Compare-and-set board
team_task_update carries the
revision you read; a stale revision
is rejected instead of overwriting
newer work.
Advisory write scopes
Overlapping scopes raise a warning;
they never lock a claim and never
authorise a write. Bash, formatters
and generators bypass every check.
Roster, mailbox and board live in the LEAD's session log. The path
<workspace>/.mpd/team/
holds legacy records only and is read by the stall detector and the workmate in-use check.
Tools every member holds: spawn_teammate (Lead-only) · send_message · list_agents · wait_agent · interrupt_agent ·
team_task_create · team_task_list · team_task_get · team_task_update
The team lifetime is the session: the roster, the mailbox and the board are projected from the Lead's live session, not from a project state directory.
